**Main line:** Nxe3 fxe3 Rxd1+ Kh2 (or any king move)

**Coaching note:**
When your opponent's queen moves to c4 attacking your a6 pawn, look for forcing moves with your centralized pieces. Here, Nxe3 is a knight fork—it attacks both the queen and rook simultaneously. After fxe3 Rxd1+, you win the rook. When you spot a loose piece attacked from two different points, check if you can create a fork.
